title: validation-evidence-package/1
description: package-manifest.json of a retained validation evidence package, written last when the package is sealed (TA3 plan VAL-1, spec P20 3.2). Producer and owner: accuratrail-validation-framework runners/evidence-package.ts. It lists every other file of the package with its byte count and SHA-256. packageHash is the SHA-256 hex of the canonical JSON of this object without packageHash: object keys in the default string order (UTF-16 code units), arrays in order, no whitespace. The SHA-256 of the file's own bytes is the contentHash the eTMF records when the manifest is filed. The package carries no signature; approval is a governance decision in the eTMF.

packageId.description: UUID v4. The package directory is <yyyymmddTHHMMSSZ of createdAt>-<version>-<first 8 hex of packageId>.

executed.description: True when the run selected a live runner or an evidence import; false for a documents package, which lists no category.

synthetic.description: Computed, never chosen: true exactly when syntheticBasis names a basis. A synthetic package is retained only under <synthetic data root>/runs/validation-packages; a package that is not synthetic never inside a synthetic data root.

syntheticBasis.description: Why the package is synthetic: --synthetic-qualification was given, a benchmark or P13 import (synthetic engineering evidence) ran, or an entry of the platform evidence plan is synthetic.

syntheticNotice.description: Present exactly when the package is synthetic. Every record of a synthetic package carries synthetic: true and every document opens with this notice.
syntheticNotice.const: SYNTHETIC ENGINEERING EVIDENCE. Synthetic data on a test stack. Not a real trial, not an approval.

releaseUnderTest.description: The release identity the run recorded (validation-release-identity/1 or /2), or null.

target.description: The target live runners used, with what its /health reported, or null when no live runner was selected.

configurationUnderTest.description: Null in this version. IQ-033 (VAL-1/validation-iq) records the declared configuration here and adds its object form.

inputs.description: Byte copies of the plan files, declarations and captures the run read, retained as inputs/<role>.json; an input holding a credential is refused.

categories.description: Counts of each evidence category, read from evidence/<category>/<category>-results.json.

files.description: Every file of the package except package-manifest.json, in code-unit order of path.

framework.description: The validation framework checkout that ran (frameworkCommit in runners/release-identity.ts).

dirty.description: Whether tracked files differed from the commit.

sha256.description: Of the copy's bytes, which equal the original's.

originalPath.description: The absolute path the run read.

failed.description: Every result that did not pass, as the category summary counts it; manual and notExecuted are parts of it.

manual.description: Manual verification rows, which never pass automatically.

notExecuted.description: Failed CONTRACT rows: cases recorded as not executed.

path.description: Posix path relative to the package directory.

recordedIn.const: eTMF governance decision on the filing of package-manifest.json; this package carries no signature
